name: Alte Mühle
beschreibung:
=== beschreibung ===

The Alte Mühle in Tirol is a hotel set in a former mill building. Its peaceful location at the edge of town serves as a perfect base for outdoor adventures in nature. The property features modern-equipped rooms with views of the valley. A highlight is the regional cuisine, served in the restaurant on-site. The historic structure of the mill is preserved in parts, such as the preserved grinding stone. Guests enjoy access to a small wellness area with a sauna. The hotel caters primarily to travelers seeking a tranquil stay for outdoor activities.
